thread:
Marcus (Eng Manager): Need a tight "one-liner" self-review + manager note I can paste into threads. Engineers hate long forms.
Ivy (People Ops): Got you. Super short set: 3 one-liners for ICs, 2-line manager paste, and modular rubric snippet.
Ivy (People Ops): 
- Self (3 lines max):
  1) Top contribution: one sentence + metric (if any).
  2) Biggest blocker: one sentence + ask.
  3) Next quarter ask: one sentence (skill or outcome).

- Manager note (copyable, 2 lines):
  - Rating + one-line rationale.
  - Evidence (single short example) + next step.

- Rubric snippet (pasteable):
  - Exceeds: consistently drives measurable impact and helps others.
  - Meets: reliably delivers owned outcomes.
  - Needs support: inconsistent delivery; needs targeted help.

Yara (Talent Partner): Process note: add one short example if you mark "Exceeds" in the calibration form. Calibration window opens next week.
Samir (Senior Eng): Can add a tiny example bank for managers to copy?
Ivy (People Ops): Yes, quick bank: "launched X, +12% success rate"; "reduced P95 latency by 30ms"; "wrote runbook and reduced oncall pages". Use as evidence.
notif-bot: Reminder: calibration form at https://intranet.redwood/calibration. Deadline 1756013600.
Marcus (Eng Manager): This is perfect  will paste into team channel and ask for 5-min fills before Friday. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
